events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description:
The element the tooltip describes: one focusable, pressable element such as a Button or an IconButton. On web the
tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus; on native it becomes the element's accessibility hint.
props.name: children

props.description: What the tooltip says: one short phrase, the sort a hover label carries, set in the app's language.
props.name: content

props.description: True to draw an arrow from the tooltip to the element. Web only; native draws no tooltip. Defaults to false.
props.name: hasArrow

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Where along that side it lines up with the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align

props.description: Delay in milliseconds before hiding tooltip
props.name: closeDelay

props.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing tooltip
props.name: delay

props.description:
Whether to let React Aria skip the enter and exit animations while its global warmup timer is
active, i.e. when moving quickly from one tooltip to another.
props.name: shouldSkipAnimation

props.description: Whether the tooltip should close when the trigger is pressed.
props.name: shouldCloseOnPress
